label: Bible Study
prompt: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the _____.
verse: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
note: Paul planted, Apollos watered — but only God makes anything grow.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not _____.
verse: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
note: Gideon panics after seeing the angel face to face; God calms him: peace, fear not, thou shalt not die.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the _____ of the ointment.
verse: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
note: Mary of Bethany's pound of spikenard filled the whole house with its odour — a gift you could smell from every room.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a _____ not turned.
verse: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
note: A flatbread burned on one side and raw on the other — Hosea's picture of half-hearted Ephraim.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verse: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
note: 'Endeavouring' — British u and all — to keep the unity of the Spirit. Unity is kept, not manufactured.
